questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic only moves in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic only moves in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic moves only in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: Before changing lanes on a multilane highway, you should:

options.text: Check your mirrors and blind spots.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors and blind spots.
questions.explanation: Look in your rearview and side mirrors to check if anyone is passing you. Also look over your shoulder to see if anyone is in your blind spot.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means that action is not permitted. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: The best way to avoid hydroplaning is to:

options.text: Keep your tires in good condition.
Slow down when roads are wet or slushy.
Watch for standing water or puddles.

questions.explanation: Wet roads make it harder to stop and easier to skid when turning. Do not use cruise control in wet or icy conditions. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: When you park parallel to a curb or edge of roadway, you must:

options.text: Park within 24 inches of the curb or edge of the roadway.
Park within 18 inches of the curb or edge of the roadway.
Park at an angle with the front of your vehicle facing out.

questions.correctAnswerText: Park within 18 inches of the curb or edge of the roadway.
questions.explanation: When parking on a public road, you must park parallel and within 18 inches of the curb or edge. Your vehicle must face the same direction as traffic on your side of the road.

questions.question: What is the only way to reduce your blood alcohol concentration (BAC)?

options.text: Wait for your body to process the alcohol.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for your body to process the alcohol.
questions.explanation: Only time reduces your BAC. Coffee, exercise, and cold showers cannot reduce your BAC or sober you up. They may keep you awake, but they do not change your BAC.

questions.question: On a freeway, you realize you missed your turn or exit. You should:

options.text: Make the turn quickly from your lane.
Continue driving until you reach the next turn, exit, or safe place to turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue driving until you reach the next turn, exit, or safe place to turn around.
questions.explanation: Do not back up if you miss your turn or exit. Go to the next turn or exit where you can safely turn around. Backing up on a freeway shoulder is illegal.

questions.question: You are driving when it begins to rain. You should:

options.text: Drive at the maximum posted speed limit.
Drive closely behind the vehicle in front of you.

questions.explanation: When rain reduces visibility, slow down. Turn on your headlights so others can see you. If rain is so heavy that you cannot see clearly, pull to the shoulder and stop until it lets up.

questions.question: A sign of a drunk driver is:
questions.explanation: Signs of drunk driving include speeding, weaving, driving slower than normal traffic, jerking movements, and quick sudden stops.

questions.question: Passing is not allowed:
questions.explanation: Passing is not allowed on hills, curves, at intersections, or at railroad crossings because it is unsafe and illegal.

questions.question: You must stop at a railroad crossing when:

options.text: A flagger tells you to stop.
Flashing red lights and gates are active.

questions.explanation: Stop at a railroad crossing if a flagger or stop sign tells you to stop, or if flashing red lights and gates are active.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is true?

options.text: Signal at least 100 feet before changing lanes to pass. Make sure no traffic is coming toward you.
Use your mirrors and look over your left shoulder to check your blind spot when passing left.
When passing, wait until you see both headlights of the car you passed in your rearview mirror before moving back to your lane.

questions.explanation: Signal at least 100 feet before changing lanes. Check your mirrors and look over your shoulder for blind spots. Wait until you see both headlights of the passed car in your rearview mirror before returning to your original lane.

questions.question: Always signal when:

options.text: Pulling into or out of a parking space.
Pulling into traffic from an alley or parking area.

questions.explanation: Always use your turn signal when changing lanes, parking, or entering traffic from an alley or parking area. This tells other drivers what you are doing and helps prevent accidents.

questions.question: It is important to try to notify the owner of another vehicle:

options.text: If you hit their vehicle while it is unattended.
If you don't like a bumper sticker on their vehicle.
If they are talking on their cell phone while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: If you hit their vehicle while it is unattended.
questions.explanation: You must try to find the owner of a vehicle you hit while it is unattended. If you cannot find them, leave a note with your name, address, and license plate number.

questions.question: When driving on slick roads, you should:

options.text: Take turns more slowly than usual.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take turns more slowly than usual.
questions.explanation: On slippery roads, drive slowly through turns and curves. This is more important than on normal roads.

questions.question: A pedestrian starts to cross in front of your vehicle. You should:

options.text: Speed up and pass in front of the pedestrian.
Stop and let the pedestrian cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and let the pedestrian cross.
questions.explanation: Always slow down and be ready to stop for pedestrians. Give pedestrians the right-of-way when they are in a crosswalk.

questions.question: To drive safely, you should:

options.text: Stay physically fit and get regular physical checkups.
Know how medicines affect your driving.
Drive only within your physical limits.

questions.explanation: Your physical health affects how safely you drive. Know your limits and only drive if you can do it safely.

questions.question: If your turn signals fail, you should use ____ to show you are turning.
questions.explanation: If your turn signals don't work, use hand signals to show when you are turning.

questions.question: If one of your tires blows out while driving, you should:

options.text: Keep the wheel straight and slow down by easing off the gas pedal.
Keep your speed and steer straight.
Swerve back and forth to warn traffic behind you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep the wheel straight and slow down by easing off the gas pedal.
questions.explanation: Hold the wheel tight and keep the car straight. Ease off the gas and do not brake until you have control. Then brake gently and pull off the road safely.

questions.question: Always signal when:

options.text: Pulling into or out of a parking space.
Pulling into traffic from a parking area or alley.

questions.explanation: Use your turn signal whenever you move left or right. Signal when entering traffic from a parking space, changing lanes, or passing another vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a sharp curve ahead. The arrow points in the direction of the curve. You may see several signs like this throughout the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign means people may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: If someone has consumed alcohol, what will help them overcome its effects?
questions.explanation: Only time will reduce alcohol's effects on a person.

questions.question: You see a driver ahead using one hand and talking to a passenger. You should:

options.text: Know that the driver is not paying full attention and is less safe.

questions.explanation: Do not get distracted while driving by talking to passengers, looking for things in your car, reading, or daydreaming. If another driver seems distracted, give them extra space because they are more likely to have an accident.

questions.question: What commonly causes traffic accidents?
questions.explanation: Driving too fast causes many crashes. Not paying attention can cause you to hit other vehicles. Following too closely causes most rear-end collisions.

questions.question: When approaching a railroad crossing, you should:
questions.explanation: When you see a railroad crossing sign, slow down, look for trains, and be ready to stop. If red lights are flashing or the gate is down, stop 15 to 50 feet from the tracks. Do not try to go around the gate.

questions.question: What do double solid yellow lines in the center of the road mean?

options.text: Passing is not allowed from either direction.
Passing is allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is not allowed from either direction.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean you cannot pass. You may only cross these lines to turn left or when passing pedestrians, cyclists, or scooter riders if the opposite lane is clear and safe.

questions.question: To change lanes, you should:

options.text: Check mirrors and signal, then change lanes.
Signal, check mirrors, check your blind spot, then change lanes.
Signal, check mirrors, and change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, check mirrors, check your blind spot, then change lanes.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, turn on your signal. Check your rearview and side mirrors. Look over your shoulder to check the blind spot in the direction you plan to move. Make sure no one else is moving into that lane. Only change lanes when it is safe.
